instruction: Look at nameplate.step. At the start of the task, open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `nameplate.step`. Create a top-face text engraving path in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Engrave the text FREECAD-CAM at 8 mm text height, centered at X=0 and Y=0, to a depth of 0.3 mm using T1. Tool definition: T1 is a small engraving cutter for the FREECAD-CAM text at 0.3 mm depth. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-16.nc.
